title: Command Frontmatter Schema
description: Lenient schema for slash-command .md file frontmatter. All fields are optional — validation only applies when frontmatter is present.

description.description: Human-readable description of the command's purpose, min 10 characters

gemini-parity.description: Whether this Claude-only command has a Gemini equivalent. 'skip' = Claude-only command, no parity check.

owner.description: Agent or team that owns this command

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the command
